name: Frozen shoulder — thawing stage
for: Frozen shoulder once the pain has settled and stiffness remains
blurb: The same movements with the range opened up and a light band on the turn-out. Three times a week is enough once the range is back; daily while it is returning.
notes: Hold each stretch for the count, breathing.
Raise the top of the wall walk and the arm raise a notch a week as they come.
Strength comes last: the band on the turn-out, then a light weight on the arm raise.

sources.title: Harvard Health — stretching exercises for frozen shoulder

items.note: Wider circles, or a light weight in the hand.
